text: Implementing a portable, theorem-delimited PALM/block-coordinate outer solver. Admission will bind level-set boundedness/coercivity, per-block convexity and Lipschitz bounds, exact or summably-inexact updates, and optional KL/semi-algebraic evidence. Runtime receipts will retain objective/decrease, block residual, normalization, stationarity, and inexactness traces; monotonicity or sufficient decrease will be enforced. Deterministic multi-start will preserve all starts and its selection rule. Generic completion can attain only stationary/coordinatewise-stationary evidence; convex nuclear/global admission remains a separate path.
